description: This file defines functions and types for sending signals/messages via the Signal protocol, including message sending, typing indicators, and read receipts. It manages configuration, target parsing, and external API calls.

methods.name: loadSignalConfigRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the 'config-runtime' module and caches the promise.

methods.name: resolveSignalRpcAccountInfo
methods.description: Resolves account info for Signal RPC, loading config if necessary.

methods.name: parseTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a SignalTarget object, identifying recipient, group, or username.

methods.name: buildTargetParams
methods.description: Builds target parameters for API calls based on target type and allowlist.

methods.name: sendMessageSignal
methods.description: Sends a message via Signal, handling media, formatting, and target parsing.

methods.name: sendTypingSignal
methods.description: Sends a typing indicator signal to a target.

methods.name: sendReadReceiptSignal
methods.description: Sends a read receipt signal for a specific message timestamp.
